provenance.selection: Lossless exact JSON values only; source author proposals/GAPs, NOT independent conclusions or adopted config

ten_copy_extents.max_functions: Inclusive maximum number of Function declarations in source.functions, checked before allocating destination.functions: Vec<b::CoreFunction>.
ten_copy_extents.max_parameters_per_function: Inclusive maximum number of Parameter declarations on any single function, checked before allocating that function's Vec<b::CoreParameter>.
ten_copy_extents.max_total_parameters: Inclusive maximum cumulative Parameter declarations across all functions in source.functions, checked via checked_add before allocating each function's Vec<b::CoreParameter>.
ten_copy_extents.max_expr_nodes: Inclusive maximum cumulative CoreExpr occurrences copied across entry and all function bodies (per structural occurrence, without Arc pointer deduplication). Checked at each root (entry and each function body) before queuing onto the expression worklist, and checked for each child Expr before allocating child Box<CoreExpr>/Vec<CoreExpr>/Vec<CoreArm> slots or pushing onto the expression worklist.
ten_copy_extents.max_copy_depth: Inclusive maximum structural CoreExpr copy depth on any root-to-leaf path. Entry and each function body root start at depth 1; each child Expr of Let, Binary, Unary, If, non-empty Call, and Match adds 1. Checked at each root and at parent expansion before allocating child slots or pushing to the worklist.
ten_copy_extents.max_match_arms: Inclusive maximum cumulative CoreArm occurrences (and their CorePatterns) copied across all Match expressions, checked via checked_add(input_arms.len()) before pattern binder cloning or Vec<b::CoreArm> allocation.
ten_copy_extents.max_name_bytes: Inclusive maximum cumulative UTF-8 bytes cloned across all String names in the copied CoreProgram: function names, parameter names, Expr::Var, Expr::Let binders, Expr::Call targets, and Pattern binders (Var, Cons, Leaf, Branch), counted per copied occurrence via checked_add(name.len()) before String::clone().
ten_copy_extents.max_list_elements: Inclusive maximum cumulative u128 (KIntC::InRange) elements copied across all Value::List literals encountered during expression copying, checked via checked_add(elements.len()) before allocating Vec<KIntC>.
ten_copy_extents.max_tree_nodes: Inclusive maximum cumulative CoreTree node occurrences (Leaf and Branch, per structural occurrence without Arc<Tree> pointer deduplication) copied across all Value::Tree literals, checked at the Value::Tree root (+1) and before each Tree::Branch expansion (+2 children, left then right) prior to allocating Box<CoreTree> or pushing onto the tree worklist.
ten_copy_extents.max_tree_depth: Inclusive maximum structural CoreTree copy depth within any Value::Tree literal (root Tree has depth 1; each Tree::Branch child has depth + 1), checked at the Value::Tree root and before each Tree::Branch allocation/worklist push.

six_required_new_R120_fields.rationale: Bounds copied CoreExpr occurrences across entry and all function bodies without conflating with parser syntactic Expr+Pattern max_ast_nodes.
Bounds copied CoreArm/CorePattern allocations across Match nodes.
Bounds cumulative cloned String UTF-8 bytes across declarations, variables, let binders, call targets, and pattern binders.
Bounds cumulative KIntC elements allocated in CoreValue::List literals before owner admission.
Bounds cumulative CoreTree Leaf/Branch allocations across CoreValue::Tree literals before owner admission.
Bounds CoreTree Branch nesting depth and tree-copy worklist depth independently of CoreExpr max_copy_depth.

remaining_owner_claimed_gaps: GAP-1 (B iterative Drop worklist/replacement-box allocations, BODY 06): `shared/owner_prepare.rs` implements iterative `Drop` for `CoreProgram`, `CoreExpr`, and `CoreTree`, avoiding native stack recursion, but allocates fresh `ew: Vec<Box<CoreExpr>>`, `tw: Vec<Box<CoreTree>>`, and replacement `Box::new(dummy_expr())` / `Box::new(dummy_tree())` nodes during `drop()`. On partial-failure unwind in `from_program_bounded` or post-admission drop of `CoreProgram`, the number of dropped nodes is bounded by the already-admitted `max_expr_nodes` and `max_tree_nodes`, but those transient `Drop` heap allocations themselves are un-metered and infallible-only (`Drop::drop` cannot return `Result`).

GAP-2 (A AST recursive Drop, BODY 02): `a::Program` holds `ExprRef = Arc<a::Expr>` and `a::Tree` holds `Arc<a::Tree>` with compiler-generated recursive `Drop` when the last strong reference drops. Bounding copy depth/nodes in `from_program_bounded` does not make `Arc<a::Program>` destruction iterative.

GAP-3 (Owner `prepare_core` / `admit` / `admit_run` host allocations, BODY 03): `owner.admit` and `owner.admit_run` allocate `ProgramView` tables (`expressions`, `occurrences`, `occurrence_paths`, `children`, `functions`, `parameters`, `arms`, `patterns`, `constants`, `constant_fields`, `names`), `WidthTable`, and `MachineImage` vectors under the owner engine's separate admission rules after `from_program_bounded` returns.

GAP-4 (Reporting, provenance, and serialization allocations, R112/R207): `project_admitted_preparation` clones declarations, provenance paths/binders, and type vectors; `draft_diagnostics` (`serde_json::Value`) and `OwnerWire`/serde artifact serialization allocate without a reporting resource guard.

GAP-5 (Public `compile_draft_host` route and H1 host guarantees): Public `compile_draft_host` implementation and module registration remain Root-controlled and out of scope here. Logical cardinality bounds in the copy bridge do not constitute a process-wide physical heap allocator, native stack byte, or wall-clock time guarantee.
